D.name: Studio Six Max with Changeroom
D.intro: The Studio Six Max with its own enclosed changeroom, about 12' × 7' overall. Change, hang your robe and step into the heat in private, with the same R24 insulated SIP walls, metal siding and cedar interior.
photos: Studio Six Max with Changeroom exterior
specs: 105" (267 cm) at the back · 101½" (258 cm) at the front
Exterior door into the changeroom; 29" × 78" door from the changeroom into the sauna
Two tiers with backrest, 84½" long; 24" upper bench, 42" total depth
4½" structural insulated panels (SIPs), built like a house
Metal siding, insulated SIP panel, foil vapour barrier, studs with a 1" air gap, tongue-and-groove cedar
Powder-coated metal siding in black, white or woodgrain, with black aluminum accents
Classic cedar tongue-and-groove, or a rhombus or hexagon cedar feature wall
9 kW electric, sized for this room

about.title: Built like a house, heats like a sauna
about.lede: A sauna with a private, enclosed changeroom, about 12' × 7' overall.
items: 4½" structural insulated panels with a foil barrier and an air gap behind the cedar keep the heat in, so it warms up faster and holds temperature in January.
A fully enclosed 40½" × 72" cedar changeroom with its own outside door, so you can change, hang towels and cool down out of the weather.
Keep the classic all-cedar look, or add a rhombus or hexagon cedar feature wall for a bolder interior.
Powder-coated metal in black, white or woodgrain, with black aluminum accents. Low-maintenance, and it never needs staining.
